summary.result: Simulated and observed areas in land use maps for city shape of 1996 showed good similarities with each other through a morphology verification method.
summary.background: A spatial simulation model for rural and urban sprawl phenomena was developed with GIS and cellular automata techniques.
summary.method: Probability of land use change for optimizing the development area was determined using a land suitability analysis method interfaced with GIS methods, based on several criteria in terms of geographic and accessibility factors such as slope of land and distance from city center.
